description: Create the deliverable file LTX23_Director_OriginalGraph_Colab.py in the repo root and implement its FOUNDATION layer: the CELL scaffolding (CELL 1..CELL 19 comment delimiters), the environment/memory-protection setup (CELL 1) and system-info (CELL 2) written so GPU-only imports are guarded/lazy, the Colab install/download cells (CELL 3 ComfyUI, CELL 4 exact pinned custom-node repos, CELL 5 models, CELL 6 LoRAs, CELL 7 audio, plus reference-image verification), and MOST IMPORTANTLY the pure-Python GRAPH PARSER (CELL 8 load JSON, CELL 9 parse into internal node/link/widgets graph + LTXDirector timeline parser) and GRAPH VALIDATOR (CELL 10) that both run standalone against the real JSON with STDLIB ONLY (no torch/comfy/psutil). Add a `--validate-only` entry point (argparse + `if __name__ == '__main__'`) that loads the real JSON, parses it, runs the validator, and prints the Section-27 report. This feature MUST leave the file py_compile-clean AND make `python3 LTX23_Director_OriginalGraph_Colab.py --validate-only` print an all-PASS validation report against /projects/sandbox/code/LTX-2.3_Director_2.0-MV-Workflow-30s.json without any GPU/ComfyUI dependency. This is the layer we can actually prove works in-sandbox.
steps: Create /projects/sandbox/code/LTX23_Director_OriginalGraph_Colab.py. Add a top module docstring stating: this re-executes the ORIGINAL ComfyUI graph LTX-2.3_Director_2.0-MV-Workflow-30s.json via JSON->parser->registry->memory-aware executor->original ComfyUI nodes; LTXDirector (node 131) is the master timeline controller; V2 is memory infra only; V3's 5-segment architecture is FORBIDDEN.

Lay out ALL cell delimiters as comments exactly per user Section 36: `# ===== CELL 1 =====` ... `# ===== CELL 19 =====` with a short title comment on each matching the user's cell list (CELL1 Environment+memory protection, CELL2 System info, CELL3 Install ComfyUI, CELL4 custom nodes, CELL5 models, CELL6 LoRAs, CELL7 audio, CELL8 load JSON, CELL9 parse graph, CELL10 validate graph, CELL11 node registry, CELL12 memory manager, CELL13 load components, CELL14 init LTXDirector timeline, CELL15 execute graph, CELL16 decode video/audio, CELL17 VHS combine, CELL18 validate output, CELL19 display/download). FEAT-001 fills CELLS 1-10; CELLS 11-19 get placeholder function stubs that RAISE NotImplementedError with a clear message (no silent pass) to be completed in FEAT-002 (keep file py_compile-clean).

CELL 1: set os.environ PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF='expandable_segments:True,garbage_collection_threshold:0.8', TORCH_CUDNN_V8_API_ENABLED='1', MALLOC_TRIM_THRESHOLD_='65536' (lift from V2 line 40-42). Import stdlib (os, sys, json, gc, argparse, ctypes, glob, subprocess, pathlib, traceback, typing). Guard torch/comfy/psutil/safetensors imports behind try/except or lazy functions so the parser+validator run with stdlib alone. Define a HAS_TORCH / HAS_PSUTIL capability flag.

CELL 2: system-info printer that reports Python version, and (only if available) GPU name via torch.cuda, RAM via psutil; degrade gracefully to 'not available in this environment' when torch/psutil are missing. Must not crash without GPU.

CELL 3: install ComfyUI (git clone https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI.git to /content/ComfyUI + pip install requirements) guarded so it only runs in a Colab-like env (e.g. checks for /content). Include a run_cmd helper (lift pattern from V2/V3).

CELL 4: clone the EXACT custom-node repos with the URLs from context.json (WhatDreamsCost-ComfyUI, ComfyUI-KJNodes, ComfyUI-GGUF, ComfyUI-LTXVideo, ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite, rgthree-comfy). Per user Section 26, prefer pinned commit hashes where available; the source JSON does not embed commit hashes, so clone by URL and add a clearly-labeled CUSTOM_NODE_PINS dict (documented as TODO-free: default to latest with a comment that pins can be set) - do NOT leave a TODO; instead expose a dict the user can populate and a comment explaining pinning. Verify required classes exist after import (LTXDirector, LTXDirectorGuide, LTXDirectorCropGuides, Power Lora Loader (rgthree), ModelPreviewOverrideKJ, LTXVLatentUpsampler, LTXVConcatAVLatent, LTXVSeparateAVLatent, LTXVConditioning, LTXVAudioVAEDecode) and RAISE the Section-25 hard error (no silent fallback) if missing.

CELL 5/6/7: download models, LoRAs, audio using the exact HuggingFace URLs and destination dirs from context.json download_urls_from_v3 (reuse V3's download_file + link_file_safe aria2c pattern). CELL 7 also verifies reference images 1.png,2.png,3.png,4.png,5.3.png in input/whatdreamscost/. Per user Section 37: a MISSING reference image is a HARD validation error with exact filename+expected dir+URL-if-known; NEVER generate placeholder images. All download cells guarded to only execute in Colab env.

CELL 8: load_workflow_json(path) -> dict. Default path resolves to the JSON next to the script (repo root) so --validate-only finds /projects/sandbox/code/LTX-2.3_Director_2.0-MV-Workflow-30s.json. Assert top-level keys present (nodes, links, groups, config, extra, version).

CELL 9: parse_graph(workflow) -> internal representation. Build: nodes_by_id {id: {type, inputs, outputs, widgets_values}}, links list normalized to (link_id, from_node, from_slot, to_node, to_slot, type), groups. Implement parse_ltxdirector_timeline(node131_widgets) that json.loads widgets_values[6] and exposes timeline_config, timeline_segments (5), audio_segments (1), motion_segments (empty) AND preserves the raw serialized string. Expose scalar timeline fields (duration=31.5, frames=756, fps=24, startFrame=0, endFrame=756) read from the widgets, not hardcoded.

CELL 10: build_validator(graph) that compares parsed graph vs expected ground truth and prints the EXACT Section-27 report format (Nodes/Connections/Models/LoRAs/Timeline/Audio/Stage 1/Stage 2/Final Video each PASS or a precise mismatch). Validate: 32 nodes; node-id->type map; LTXDirector id 131 present with its 8 outputs; 4 LoRAs with strengths 0.4/0.6/0.7/0.9 all on; model/VAE names; sampler=euler x2; schedulers linear_quadratic [8,1.0] and [4,0.42]; guide strengths 1.0 and 0.5; CFG=1; timeline frames=756 fps=24 duration=31.5; audio file 'Late night trap.mp3' trimStart~446.9222739141953 audioDurationFrames=2880; VHS params (frame_rate 24, crf 8, pix_fmt yuv420p, format video/h264-mp4, filename_prefix LTX2.3/Video). On any mismatch, print the exact expected-vs-found and make validate() return False so the caller can stop execution.

Add argparse with `--validate-only` (and default workflow path). Under `if __name__ == '__main__'`: if --validate-only, run load_workflow_json + parse_graph + validator and sys.exit(0 if all PASS else 1). Ensure this path imports NOTHING GPU-related.
Run `python3 -m py_compile LTX23_Director_OriginalGraph_Colab.py` and `python3 LTX23_Director_OriginalGraph_Colab.py --validate-only` from /projects/sandbox/code and confirm all-PASS.
acceptance_criteria: File /projects/sandbox/code/LTX23_Director_OriginalGraph_Colab.py exists with `# ===== CELL 1 =====` through `# ===== CELL 19 =====` delimiters.
